verdict.rationale: DeepSeek ships no first-party SDK in the evidence. Instead its docs say the API is OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible, so developers can use the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs by changing configuration. The docs also note native support for the Responses API format and give streaming and function-calling examples in those formats. That lets developers build with mature SDKs, but they are third-party SDKs pointed at DeepSeek, not DeepSeek-maintained ones. Missing for 10: a DeepSeek-maintained official SDK, SDK reference docs for DeepSeek-specific features (e.g., thinking mode, user_id), independent hands-on corroboration of SDK compatibility.
